stages.name: axes
stages.claim: x: RFF minus DeGroot held-out likelihood with the kernel alone. y: the same with every mechanism on. Above the diagonal the mechanisms made the data look more nonlinear.

stages.name: unchanged
stages.claim: For seven panels the verdict does not move; six of 15 are nonlinear under the kernel alone.

stages.name: flipped
stages.claim: ADAMS-high and CMV look nonlinear only when retention is omitted.

stages.name: switched
stages.claim: Six panels are linear under the kernel-only fit and nonlinear under the full model: SENATE, HOUSE, BECKER, TAKACS-S1, TAKACS-S2-disliking and VK-counting. Nine of 15 are nonlinear with the mechanisms.
